outcome: Evaluate and implement TrendAI Vision One for consolidated cloud and hybrid security visibility and exposure analysis, under a measured pilot and governed approval process.
overview: TrendAI Vision One addresses alerts and control records are fragmented, delaying a defensible review of priority exceptions in cross-industry operations. The first proof of value uses cloud assets, workload telemetry and security finding feeds. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is validated material exposures exceeding remediation threshold, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: cloud assets, workload telemetry and security finding feeds; define validated material exposures exceeding remediation threshold and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from IT and platform operations director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including sample false positives and adjudications with independent risk reviewers.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
